Move a rendered map's view

Source: R/arc-map-proxy.R
arc_goto.Rd

arc_goto() animates the view, unlike set_view() on a proxy, which jumps to the new position. arc_screenshot() captures the view as a PNG data URL and sends it back as input$<output_id>$screenshot.

Usage

arc_goto(proxy, center = NULL, zoom = NULL, extent = NULL, duration = NULL)

arc_screenshot(proxy, format = "png")

Arguments

proxy

Defines which arc_map_proxy() to act on.

center

default NULL. Defines the target centre as c(lon, lat).

zoom

default NULL. Defines the target zoom level.

extent

default NULL. Defines the target extent, overriding center and zoom.

duration

default NULL. Defines the animation length in milliseconds.

format

default "png". Defines the screenshot format, "png" or "jpg".

Value

proxy, invisibly.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  arc_map_proxy("map") |>
    arc_goto(center = c(-79, 35.5), zoom = 8)
}
